author: Trending Desk
title: Viral Instagram Reel showing street food vendor in Mumbai sparks nationwide safety debate
description: A food safety reel recorded at a popular chowpatty stall in Mumbai, Maharashtra surpassed 40 million views on Instagram, prompting state food safety inspections.
content: Instagram creators across Mumbai are remixing the original viral reel with contrasting hygiene reviews.

author: Express Web Desk
title: Bengaluru techie's viral Instagram Reel on suburban train commute goes viral
description: Commuters in Bengaluru, Karnataka celebrate a creative Instagram video highlighting quick rail transfers that beat Outer Ring Road traffic gridlock.
content: The clip has struck a chord with hundreds of thousands of daily office goers across the Karnataka capital.

author: Offbeat Desk
title: Kerala college dance troupe's Onam celebration Instagram Reel clocks 25 million views
description: Students in Kochi, Kerala blend classical folk steps with contemporary beats in an electrifying campus performance praised by international creators.
content: The performance has become one of the most shared festive reels from southern India this season.

author: Buzz Desk
title: Delhi Metro aesthetic timelapse Reel by architectural student trends across India
description: Visual artist captures the futuristic glass canopy and architectural geometry of New Delhi transit stations in a viral Instagram reel.
content: Viewers marvelled at the cinematic color grade that transformed daily commutes into art.

author: Culture Reporter
title: Chennai heritage filter and carnatic remix creates trending audio wave on Instagram
description: Musicians from Chennai, Tamil Nadu fuse veena ragas with lo-fi beats, generating over 100,000 creator reels across South Asia.
content: The audio trend demonstrates the vibrant intersection of classical Indian art and digital youth culture.

author: Tech Desk
title: Meta rolls out creator monetization upgrades on Instagram for Indian micro-influencers
description: New in-stream revenue tools and performance bonuses announced for digital creators operating outside metro hubs across Tier-2 Indian cities.
content: Digital strategists highlight the accelerated economic impact of regional content in India.
